# A13-S35: Correspondence

Correspondence extract. [████] marks redaction; […] marks omission.

[…]
Thank you for your email.
I am sorry you have not received the pictures for approval. That is a mistake.
You are the one who approves, of course.

[████] is a skilled designer and is thoroughly nerding, we have even purchased a program that can improve the quality of the pictures AI generates so that they look the best and sharpest. The pictures chosen are taken from the collage. Personally, I am quite into the genderless colors [████] posted because I also think the quality is like a flowing non-human mass, and reminds of a human, without being one.

The red and lime green mix is – for someone who sees colors – quite unpleasant and flickers enormously because they are complementary colors, to make the posters readable from a distance, a contrast color has been chosen – otherwise it can't be read far away – not to go against you, but to create attention. Of course, we shall use images with red and green, and we also make posters for the election campaign with those images when the time comes. Having said all this, you must of course approve, but just remember that what has been acted on is to promote you and your (and you should of course feel it does).

[████] messages are very confrontational, I will address that with her.
